description: This PHP class defines a model for a specific report type within the OrangeHRM PIM API module. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits to facilitate serialization. The class constructs the model using a Report entity, configuring filters and attribute names.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportModel
classes.description: A model class representing a predefined report within the OrangeHRM PIM API, used for serialization and API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Report entity, setting relevant filters and attribute names for serialization.
